Source issues and acknowledgements

GPS diagnosis and media ingest publish issues through SourceIssueRepository. source_issue identifies a semantic defect by source, content revision, and finding hash. Readable revisions use streamed SHA-256 of original contents. Unreadable episodes persist one UUID until reading succeeds. File size, modification time, message wording, retries, and rounded measurements are not acknowledgement identities. Domain severity escalation changes the finding hash.

REVIEW issues require acceptance. INFORMATION includes empty-file skips and the GPS assessment-limit exception. Incomplete assessment remains explicit and does not resolve unchecked stages. Complete stages resolve absent findings; readable changed contents resolve the older revision. Removal resolves history while retaining indexed_file; hard deletion and database reset cascade through issues and acknowledgements.

source_issue_acknowledgement stores one current row per issue and canonical authenticated account name. Duplicate inserts preserve the timestamp; Reopen deletes the row. Login case variants share a key. Account renaming starts a new scope. Shared demo credentials share acknowledgements; browser cleanup does not clear them. track_review_decision stores shared map/statistics choices and their actor separately. Review later stores nothing. No legacy issue backfill is run.

The targets endpoint returns a complete immutable selection of issue IDs and revisions in one read transaction. Its default state is PENDING; state=ACKNOWLEDGED returns the complete selection for Reopen, including issues beyond the visible page. pendingFileCount is zero for an acknowledged selection. Per-file acknowledgement uses the issue revisions displayed in Review. Bulk actions show the snapshot's file and issue counts before submitting that selection once. One transaction validates active reviewable rows under existing source guards and applies set-based writes in bounded batches. New, changed, resolved, or excluded targets are not accepted by old requests. The result includes changed/already-acknowledged/stale counts, exact changedTargets, and account source summaries. Undo reopens only those newly acknowledged targets, preserving acknowledgements another device saved before the submission. A failure rolls back all batches. Writes are not automatically retried.

The client serializes issue actions and updates shared summaries only after a confirmed response. Older in-flight status reads cannot restore superseded pending counts. Feedback survives list refresh and navigation. Failed Undo keeps its targets and a retry action. Navigation is disabled during submission; per-file advance requires the current source to have no pending issues. Reassessment refreshes diagnosis and its issue controls together. Cross-device opposite actions follow database write order. Map, Review, Processing, and overview summaries count distinct pending files, including imported GPS quality findings. Raw processing totals and operational failures remain separate. Acknowledgement cannot repair data or make timing reliable. There is no browser acknowledgement token or freshness snooze.

Stable zero-byte GPS/media files finish as SKIPPED, distinct from configured EXCLUDED. Normal content changes queue them again. Existing imported records are retained; the current empty-source explanation identifies this. Content failures remain reviewable; unexpected import/service failures retain operational recovery. See Processing.
